label: EWSR1::WT1

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
WT1 encodes a zinc-finger transcriptional regulator involved in kidney and gonadal development.

The fusion joins the EWSR1 activation region to WT1 zinc-finger DNA-binding sequences, converting WT1-associated transcription into an oncogenic program. It is characteristic of desmoplastic small round cell tumor, typically presenting with disseminated intra-abdominal disease.
